Our story

A family truck with a phoenix heart

Our truck carries the name La Fénix — the phoenix — a symbol of rising, renewing and starting again stronger. That's the spirit the Fenix family cooks with: honest Mexican food, made fresh and served like you're one of our own.

We're a family-owned business, grounded in faith, serving our neighbors across Hillsborough, Durham and the surrounding counties. When you step up to our window, you're not just ordering lunch — you're being fed by family.

Family-Owned

Run by the Fenix family — the same hands cooking, serving and greeting you at the window.

Faith-Grounded

Our faith guides how we work and how we treat people — with gratitude, honesty and heart.

Four Counties

Serving Durham, Orange, Wake & Alamance counties — at the truck and at your events.

Party catering

Bring La Fénix to your party

Birthdays, gatherings and special events — our truck brings the tacos, quesadillas and vegan & vegetarian options to you. Tell us about your event and we'll take it from there.
